timeline.summary: On April 28, 2026, Torrent Pharmaceuticals announced that its equity shareholders approved the Scheme of Amalgamation with J. B. Chemicals & Pharmaceuticals at the NCLT-convened meeting.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,197 Cr (+41.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹389 Cr (-21.9% YoY).
On May 22, 2026, Torrent Pharmaceuticals released its investor presentation detailing Q4 FY26 and full-year revenue summaries.
CHINTAN M. TRIVEDI, Director, shared the audio recording of the conference call on audited financial results for Q4FY26 and FY26 on 22-May-26 via the company’s website.
On May 27, 2026, Torrent Pharmaceuticals filed the transcript of its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call.
Torrent Investments Limited declared no encumbrance on Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited shares under SEBI(SAST) Regulations for FY2026.
Torrent Pharmaceuticals dissolved its wholly owned subsidiary Curatio Inc., Philippines on 10-Jul-26
Torrent Pharmaceuticals completed the share allotment for the amalgamation scheme with JB Chemicals on 20-Jul-26
Torrent Pharma reported Q1FY27 results with 55% YoY revenue growth to ₹4,921 Cr, driven by JB Pharma amalgamation.

Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited’s Chairman Samir Mehta announced the Postal Ballot result on 07th September 2026, approving Shanti Ekambaram’s appointment as Independent Director with 99.98% valid votes.
Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited increased investment in associate Torrent Urja to ₹11.88 Cr for hybrid power project on 28-Sep-2026
2026-10-07: Torrent Pharmaceuticals affirmed at IND AA+ with positive outlook by India Ratings
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹4,979 Cr (+50.8% YoY), net profit ₹534 Cr (-9.6% YoY).
Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited shared the audio recording of its conference call with analysts/investors on Q2FY27 and H1FY27 results via its website on 23-Oct-26, signed by CHINTAN M. TRIVEDI.
